**Monte Alén National Park** ([Spanish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_language "Spanish language"): _Parque nacional de Monte Alén_[Equatorial Guinea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Equatorial_Guinea "Equatorial Guinea"). It was established in 1990. With an area of 2,000 km2 (770 sq mi),[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-1) it is the country's largest [national park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_park "National park").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-FOOTNOTEDaviesBrown200775-2) The [goliath frog](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goliath_frog "Goliath frog"), one of the prominent [amphibians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amphibians "Amphibians") found in the park, is the biggest frog in the world; hunting it is prohibited.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-FOOTNOTESirohi200833-3)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-FOOTNOTEDorcasGibbons201113-4)
## Geography and environment
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Geography and environment")]
The park has an area of 2,000 km2 (770 sq mi) and lies within the elevation range of 300–1,250 m (980–4,100 ft). It was declared a national park under a presidential decree in 2000 in addition to 13 other areas.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Park-5)
The highest peaks of Monte Alén and Monte Mitra lie within the limits of the park. [Uoro River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uoro_River "Uoro River") lies to the west of the park. The eastern part of the park is bounded by the Niefang-Gabon road. There are a few patches of rock outcrops. Lake Atoc (Lago Atoc) has forest cover throughout its entire catchment.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Park-5)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Bird-6)
Trekking paths are well laid out in the park. Logging operation within the park is fully controlled.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-FOOTNOTERichmondButlerClammerCorne20131191-7)
### Climate
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Climate")]
The climate is hot humid equatorial, with an average temperature of about 25 °C (77 °F) in the lowland area and 20–23 °C (68–73 °F) in the highlands. The mean annual rainfall is between 3,000–3,500 mm (120–140 in).[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Park-5)
### Wildlife
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Wildlife")]
[![](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Goliath_Frog.jpg/250px-Goliath_Frog.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Goliath_Frog.jpg) A model of the [goliath frog](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goliath_frog "Goliath frog") (_Conraua goliath_) in the [American Museum of Natural History](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Museum_of_Natural_History "American Museum of Natural History")
The park has recorded 265 species of birds and has been designated an [Important Bird Area](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Important_Bird_Area "Important Bird Area") (IBA) by [BirdLife International](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BirdLife_International "BirdLife International") because it supports significant populations of many bird species.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-bli-8) Some of the prominent species include three montane species: [grey cuckooshrike](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grey_cuckooshrike "Grey cuckooshrike"), [pink-footed puffback](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pink-footed_puffback "Pink-footed puffback") and [black-capped woodland warbler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black-capped_woodland_warbler "Black-capped woodland warbler"); [Uganda woodland warbler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uganda_woodland_warbler "Uganda woodland warbler"), [grey-necked rockfowl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grey-necked_rockfowl "Grey-necked rockfowl"), [Zenker's honeyguide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zenker's_honeyguide "Zenker's honeyguide"), [Tessmann's flycatcher](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tessmann's_flycatcher "Tessmann's flycatcher") and [Gabon batis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabon_batis "Gabon batis").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Bird-6)
The park has 105 [mammal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mammal "Mammal") species which includes 16 species of [primates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Primates "Primates").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Embassy-9) These include [black colobus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_colobus "Black colobus"), [collared mangabey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Collared_mangabey "Collared mangabey"), [mandrills](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mandrill "Mandrill"), [gorillas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gorilla "Gorilla") and [chimpanzees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chimpanzee "Chimpanzee"). Other mammal species include [bush elephants](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/African_bush_elephant "African bush elephant"), [forest elephants](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/African_forest_elephant "African forest elephant") and [Grasse's shrews](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grasse's_shrew "Grasse's shrew").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Bird-6)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-FOOTNOTEPlanet2014573-10)
Sixty-five species of reptiles are reported,[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Embassy-9) including [crocodiles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crocodile "Crocodile").[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-FOOTNOTEPlanet2014573-10) Amphibians include _[Petropedetes palmipes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petropedetes_palmipes "Petropedetes palmipes")_[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-11) and _[Leptodactylodon stevarti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leptodactylodon_stevarti "Leptodactylodon stevarti")_ ,[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-12) which are in the [IUCN Red List](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IUCN_Red_List "IUCN Red List"). [Goliath frogs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goliath_frog "Goliath frog") are found in the southern part of the park.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Bird-6)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-FOOTNOTEPlanet2014573-10)
### Conservation
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Conservation")]
[![](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/eb/Nationalpark_Monte_Al%C3%A9n.jpg/250px-Nationalpark_Monte_Al%C3%A9n.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Nationalpark_Monte_Al%C3%A9n.jpg)Monte Alén
In 1989, conservation of the forest area of the park was zoned for purpose of awarding concessions for logging, and agroforestry activities were encouraged.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-FOOTNOTEResources198923-13) A study conducted under [USAID](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USAID "USAID") observed that hunting of mammals in the park was a serious issue which needed urgent remedial conservation action.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-Park-5) By 2005, Caldecott reported that agriculture, hunting, and logging were not allowed in the park.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Al%C3%A9n_National_Park#cite_note-FOOTNOTECaldecottMiles2005345-14)
